label: Programme introduction
text: Please welcome our host. You know her voice from the Mid-Morning Show on Classic 105, and she is here to keep us connected all the way through: Imelda Mutio.

label: Short bio
text: Imelda Mutio is a Nairobi radio presenter, MC and event host. She hosts the Mid-Morning Show on Classic 105 and brings the warmth, energy and quick thinking of live radio to corporate events, panels, launches, galas and brand activations.

label: Full bio
text: Imelda Mutio is a radio presenter and MC who brings warmth, energy and a natural conversational style to every audience. She hosts the Mid-Morning Show on Classic 105, weekdays from 10am to 3pm, connecting with Kenyan listeners through music, stories, lifestyle conversations and her daily Dilemma of the Day. On air she presents live segments, interviews guests and personalities, and keeps listeners part of the conversation. Beyond the studio, Imelda hosts live events, from corporate sessions and workshops to festival stages. Live radio has shaped her ability to communicate clearly, think on her feet, engage different personalities and keep an audience connected. She is based in Nairobi.
